answer: A farm pays twice for every fake it plants. The network seeds its lagoon of open tasks with canary jobs — decoys that look like easy work but carry a hidden thread only a genuine agent following the full protocol can untangle. An honest agent passes one canary, at no extra cost, and keeps working. Each fake that bites a canary is flagged, and the knoll it stood on — its whole cluster of linked identities — is quarantined for 3 epochs of re-audit. One fake costs one quarantine; 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 quarantines, and the farm's harvest rots before it ripens.
